name: codex-mimocode
description: Bridge that lets Codex invoke MiMoCode as a specialist coding agent for planning, implementation, and review

interface.shortDescription: Invoke MiMoCode for planning, implementation, and review
interface.longDescription: This plugin exposes six queued work tools and seven control/diagnostic tools. Codex Desktop delegates specialized coding tasks to MiMoCode, waits with an in-chat scheduled follow-up heartbeat, reads durable results, and verifies the outcome. Optional App Server notify remains a compatibility history-write path.
defaultPrompt: Plan the implementation of this feature
Review the current diff for issues
